name: Student
description: Learns fast. No strengths, no weaknesses — the baseline everything else is measured against.

name: Fighter
description: An extra weapon slot. More arms, more steel.

name: Rogue
description: Quick on their feet. Hits harder with Light weapons, worse with Heavy ones.

name: Mage
description: Attuned to Magic. Weapons carrying the Magic tag hit harder.

name: Sentinel
description: Slow and armored. Starts with more health and takes less from everything.
